name: CoNC-ExactTopo-v1.1
reason: All six initial runs selected epoch zero by DEV cross entropy. Their trained heads increased confidence and DEV loss. This follow-up is designed before any new TEST scoring.
scope: same architecture, seeds, full TRAIN, DEV, threshold and two matched arms

training.selection: minimum DEV classification cross entropy, excluding penalty

global_recipe_selection: Compare mean selected DEV CE for exact_topo across three seeds between initial and regularized recipes; apply the winning recipe to both arms and all seeds; tie favors initial recipe. Never select a seed.
test_gate: All six regularized runs completed; global recipe and all six selected checkpoints hashed before TEST scoring.
reporting: Preserve both recipes and disclose DEV-informed follow-up. Historical family TEST is retrospective, not a pristine holdout.
